simple.meaning: מְזוּזָה (mᵉzûwzâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a door-post (as prominent ).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 12:7. The surrounding context includes blood, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מְזוּזָה (H4201) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: מְזוּזָה (mᵉzûwzâh) / H4201 is traced through Exodus 12:7, Exodus 12:22, Exodus 12:23, Exodus 21:6 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.full: H4201. mezuzah מְזוּזָה noun feminine door-post, gate-post , absolute ׳מ Exod 21:6 ; Isa 57:8 ; construct מְזוּזַת 1Sam 1:9 ; Ezek 46:2 + 41:21 (strike out ᵑ6 Co compare ᵐ5 Hi), 45:19 (twice in verse) (in both ᵑ9 ᵑ6 ᵐ5 מְזוּזוֺת Co); suffix מְזוּזָתִי 43:8 , מְזוּזָתָם 43:8 ; plural מְזוּזוֺת 1Kin 6:31 2 t. (+ Ezek 45:19 (twice in verse) Co see above), מְזוּזֹת Exod 12:7 4 t., מְזֻזוֺת Deut 6:9 ; Judg 16:3 ; — door-post, gate-post , 1 of dwelling-house Exod 12:7 (P), 12:22 ; 12:23 ; 21:6 (all J E), Deut 6:9 ; 11:20 compare Isa 57:8 ; also ׳מ מְּתָחָ֑י Prov 8:34 , מְזוּזָתָם Ezek 43:8 ; of Solomon's house 1Kin 7:5 . 2 of house of ׳י : a. of the pre-Solomonic sanctuary of ׳י 1Sam 1:9 . b. of Solomon's temple 1Kin 6:33 ; of the דְּבִיר 6:31 . c. of Ezekiel's temple Ezek 41:21 (strike out Co see above), 43:8 ( מְזוּזָתִי ), ׳מ הַבַּיִת 45:19 , ׳מ שַׁעַר 45:9 , compare 46:2 . 3 of city-gates Judg 16:3 .
